query_analysis.original_query: A horizontal separator operates under steady-state conditions with a constant flow of gas and liquid phases. Develop a differential equation relating the pressure drop to liquid holdup, assuming frictional losses dominate.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a differential equation that relates the pressure drop to the liquid holdup in a horizontal separator operating under steady-state conditions with constant gas and liquid flows, assuming that frictional losses are the primary cause of pressure drop.
